tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bka' nye bar mkho ba rnams gcig tu bsdebs pa'i glegs bam 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i bum bzang zhes bya ba'i mtshan byang bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta a k+ṣa ra bcu gcig pa nyer bar bskyed pa bcu bzhi mchis pa'i ya gyal rgya mtshos rnam par spud pa'i prāstā ras bcings pa'o// ༄༅// sarbebibhedas+yakareṇadhar+m+mās+saṃshāsanāḥpatrasahasraphul+lā/ d+madhūt+sabaḥkārakayiṣ+ṭasid+dhishashreyaḥprayats+tshan+tugurūṣ+ṇarasmyā// ༄༅// chos kun rnam par 'byed pa'i 'od zer gyis// yang dag bstan pa'i 'dab stong phye ba las// 'dod pa'i dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston mkhan// bla ma nyin mor byed pas dge legs stsol// gser gyi mngal can la sogs 'jig rten na// cher rlom yongs kyi rin chen cod paṇa rtser// zhabs zung ngal gsor spyod pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// byang chub ma thob de srid ston par gzung*// de yi zhal gyi sgros dmar 'dzum pa yi// khong nas rnam spros ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs// 'dus pa'i rjod byed brjod byar 'brel ba'i lung*// khams gsum nyon mongs spong byed chos la lam// bstan pa'i rgya mtshor zhi dul 'gros mdzes shing*// bshad sgrub mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba'i glu// mi zad 'byin pa bstan 'dzin ngang pa'i khyu// gzhan don byang chen bgrod pa'i grogs su spyon// 'di na rgyal bas legs par gdams pa'i bka'// nye bar mkho rnams gcig tu bsdebs pa yi// glegs bam 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i bum bzang gi /dkar chag rgyas min yi ge'i lam nas gleng*// de la rang re lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i ston pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang*/ 'jig rten thams cad la snyoms pa'i thugs brtse rmad du byung ba'i bdag nyid can/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ges legs par gsungs pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa 'di nyid ni/ su zhig gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan pa dang bde ba gya nom pa la reg par 'dod pa dag gis rten dang gling dang dpung gnyen mchog tu rigs par byas nas rnam pa thams cad du de nyid yi ger 'dri ba dang*/

klog pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ kha ton du byed pa dang*/ mnyan pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni nam mkha' ltar tshad gzung du med par 'thob pa ni gcam bu min pa'i nges pa ste/ de'ang ji skad du/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na// sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas// gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te// sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags// zhes dang*/ yang phal po che las/ su zhig sangs rgyas chos la dad cing sems byed pa// de ni chags med thub pa rnams kyis dbang yang bskur// zhes dang*/ mdo las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel// bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub// bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur// mya ngan las 'das zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po 'thob// ces dang*/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ gang zhig chos kyi sbyin byin zhing*// 'dri ba dang ni nyan pa dang*// rtag tu de dag sems nyid dang*// gal te de dag goms byed na// skye ba dran pa rtag tu 'thob// gang zhig lha yi 'jig rten na// dpag bsam gyi ni shing gi mchog /don rnams thams cad 'grub byed pa// lha tshogs bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// de ni bde ba mchog sbyin pa'i// rgya che ba yi 'bras bu yin// zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa'i sman yon gyis yid yongs su drangs te/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu las 'phral du nye bar mkho ba'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bka' yang dag par ma nges pa rnams kyang gnas skabs kyi rkyen sel la sogs pa la lhag par bsngags pa ci rigs pa rnams 'gro phan che ba la dgongs nas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i bka' 'dus kyi glegs bam 'dod dgu'i bum bzang zhes bya ba par du bskrun pa 'di nyid kyi chos tshan rnams kyi grangs 'phral du rtogs par sla ba'i ched du dkar chag tu 'god pa la/

mchog dman gyi rim pas thog mar rgyud dang*/ de nas mdo dang*/ mthar sna tshogs kyi skor te sde tshan gsum du phye ba las/ dang por rgyud du gtogs pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ 'phags 14 pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo// 'phags 19 pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po/ de bzhin 20 gshegs pa'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa 22 ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba/ de'i gzungs 27 sngags/ 'phags 27 pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can/ 'phags 34 pa gtsug tor 'bar ba/ sangs 34 rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags 39 pa shākya thub pa'i snying po/ 'phags 39 pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po gnyis// zla 40 ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ sangs 40 rgyas spyi'i snying po/ rin chen 40 gtsug tor gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ 'phags 40 pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ rje btsun 42 ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'phags 44 ma lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig ces bya ba/ 'phags 46 ma sgrol ma'i gzungs/ sgrol ma 46 rang gis dam bcas pa/ ri khrod ma 46 lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs/ 'phags 47 ma 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags 46 pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ 'phags 49 pa stobs po che/ rdo rje rnam 61 rnam par 'joms pa/ mi rgod rnam 63 'joms/ bar du 63 gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/ spyan ras 64 gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs/ spyan 64 ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po/ seng 64 ge sgra'i gzungs/ don yod zhags 65 pa'i gzungs/ kun du 66 bzang po'i gzungs/ khro bo rme 70 brtsegs la bstod pa'i sngags/ rdo rje mi pham 71 pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed/ 'phags

74 pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ bu mang 75 po so so 'brang ba/ gzhan 76 gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ stong 'gyur 77 zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ phyir 77 bzlog rnam rgyal/ phyir 79 bzlog stobs chen/ las 79 kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ 'phags 80 pa g.yul las rgyal ba/ lus 83 ngag yid gsum bcings grol/ rgyal 84 ba can/ dpal 87 chen mo'i mdo/ phal 88 chen gsung bsgrags pa dang mnyam pa'i gzungs/ dbyig 88 dang ldan pa/ dug 90 sel ba/ bklags 91 pas grub pa rig pa'i rgyal mo sor mo can/ chos 91 thams cad kyi yum/ gtsug 92 gi nor bu/ yi ge 93 drug pa/ stong phrag 95 nyi shu lnga pa'i gzungs/ stong phrag 95 brgya pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi gzungs/ phar 96 phyin drug gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ phar 96 phyin bcu'i snying po/ tshad med 96 pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ stong phrag 96 brgya pa dang*/ phal 96 po che dang*/ sdong pos 96 bkod pa dang*/ ting nge 96 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo dang*/ rig 96 pa'i rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma dang*/ lang 96 kar gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad bklags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ rdo rje 96 'jigs byed kyi gzungs/ 'gro lding 98 ba'i gsang sngags/ sprin 100 chen po/ gza' 113 rnams kyi yum/ mchog thob pa'i rig 115 sngags/ stong chen mo nas 115 byung ba'i sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ rdo rje mchu 116 zhes bya ba klu'i dam tshig gnam 120 lcags mchu/ lcags 124 mchu nag po/ mig 126 rnam par sbyong ba/ mig 128 nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ k+ṣa 128 ya'i nad sel ba'i sngags/ gzhang 128 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ nad 129 thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ rims 129 nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs gnyis/ rma 130 bya chen mo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ bgegs 131 sel ba'i gzungs/ bar du 131 gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs/ nor gyi 133 rgyun zhes bya ba/

nor 136 bu bzang po'i gzungs/ tshogs 137 bdag snying po/ dbang 138 bskur ba/ sman 139 bla'i snying po/ rgyal 139 ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ snang ba 139 mtha' yas dang*/ pad+ma'i spyan 140 gyi gzungs/ snang 140 ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa/ dri ma med 140 pa'i gzungs/ sgrib pa 144 rnam sel gyi gzungs/ 'jam 145 dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ 'jam 145 dpal gyi mod btsugs pa/ 'jam 146 dpal gyi mtshan/ 'jam 146 dpal gyi sngags yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i cho ga zhal 146 bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ spyan 148 ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ lus 150 kyi dbyibs mdzes pa/ byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan 152 'bum/ 'jigs 153 pa chen po brgyad las rnam par grol ba/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can 153 gyi cho ga lag na rdo rje'i mtshan 154 brgyad po gsang sngags dang bcas pa/ rmi lam 156 mthong ba/ lag 156 na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi bdag po'i gzungs/ rdo rje 157 phra mo thogs pa med pa/ bdud 158 rtsi thab sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa/ be con chen 159 po/ khro bo mi g.yo ba'i 161 gzungs/ mdangs 162 phyir 'phrog pa/ gnod 'dzin chu 163 dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bde byed/ gnod 'dzin gyi 164 mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad/ gnod 'dzin 166 dpal/ mtshan mo bzang 167 po/ chos kyi 167 rgya mtsho/ gdon mi 173 za ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub 173 pa rig pa chen mo/ rten cing 'brel 173 bar 'byung ba'i snying po 177 gsum/ lha mo skul 177 byed ma/ 'phags pa 178 grags ldan ma/ lha mo 179 brgyad kyi gzungs/ yon yongs su sbyong ba'i 180 gzungs gnyis/ 'brum bu'i nad 180 dang*/ ma 181 zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba'i gzungs/ sdang 181 ba dang sdig pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang 181 khro ba zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ tshig 182 btsan pa'i gzungs/ bdag 182 srung ba/ don thams 182 cad 'grub pa/ las 182 grub pa/ mi 182 dga' bar byed pa/ yid 182 du 'ong ba/ mgrin 183 pa snyan pa'i gzungs/

bcings 183 pa las grol ba/ shes rab bskyed pa'i gzungs tshan 184 gsum/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs tshan 185 gnyis/ nyin 185 gcig la sh+lau ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs tshan gsum/ sh+lau ka sum 185 stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ mi brjed 185 pa'i gzungs/ phyag bya ba'i 185 gzungs/ rims dang srog chags 185 kyis mi tshugs pa/ dug zhi bar 185 byed pa/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrogs 186 pa/ bdud 186 skrag par byed pa/ rma 186 'byor bar byed pa/ me'i zug 186 rngu zhi bar byed pa/ mkhris 186 pa'i nad dang bad 186 kan gyi nad sel bar byed pa/ skran zhi ba'i 186 gzungs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi 186 gzungs/ rin po che bdar 187 ba'i gzungs/ bskor ba'i 187 gzungs/ dkon mchog gi rten la bskor ba bya ba'i 187 gzungs/ ye shes 187 skar mda'i snying po/ su 187 ru pa'i gzungs/ yi dwags 188 mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'jur 193 'gegs zhes bya/ lus 195 kyi zag pa sbyin par gtong ba'i gzungs/ dpal 195 mgon po nag po'i gzungs/ nag po chen po'i gzungs 196 rims nad thar byed/ lha mo nag mo chen mo'i 196 gzungs/ lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya 196 rtsa brgyad pa rnams so// //gnyis pa mdo'i sde tshan du gtogs pa dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa/ shes phyin rdo rje gcod pa 23 / shes phyin zab mo snang 36 ba/ shes phyin gyi mtshan 37 brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'da' 39 ka ye shes/ nam 40 mkha'i snying po/ sa'i snying po'i mtshan 61 brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ sa'i 63 mdo/ dpang skong 64 phyag brgya pa/ ltung ba 68 bshags pa/ bzang 70 po spyod pa'i smon lam/ byams 73 pa'i smon lam/ glang ru 75 lung bstan/ phyogs 87 bcu mun sel/ khang bu 94 brtsegs pa'i mdo/ byams 98 pas zhus pa chos brgyad pa/ khye'u rin chen 102 zla bas zhus pa/ bgres 110 mos zhus pa/ dkon mchog gsum

110 la skyabs su 'gro ba/ nyi 116 ma'i mdo/ zla 117 ba'i mdo/ yangs 117 pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ shis 120 par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ phun 124 sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis rnams so// //gsum pa nyer mkho sna tshogs kyi sde tshan la/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur ba'i gzungs/ rin po che tshe'i sgru 4 ba pa/ tshe dpag tu med pa 6 thams cad kyi snying po/ nor lha 6 gser 'od/ gser 'od 10 g.yang skyabs/ gzhan 18 gyis mi thub pa yang dag shes kyi gzungs/ phyugs 18 nad zhi byed/ a 19 pa ra tsi ta'i gzungs/ gter 19 bdag drug gi gzungs/ tshogs 21 bdag gi gzungs/ nor rgyun 21 ma'i gzungs bstod pa dang bcas pa/ lha mo nor rgyu 22 na gyi gzungs/ nor 23 phyugs srung zhing spel byed/ tshogs 24 bdag 'bru spel/ lug 25 gzungs/ lug 26 nad zhi ba/ rta 27 gzungs kyi rigs tshan lnga/ phyir bzlog 28 ngan sngags kyi 'khor lo/ tsakra bcu 33 gsum pa'i gzungs/ nyes 34 pa kun sel/ gser 'od rnga 36 sgra/ sme 39 bdun zhes pa skar ma'i mdo/ mdo 43 thig rgya nag kag 60 bzlog gnam sa 62 snang brgyad/ klu'i dpang 67 skong*/ bkra 76 shis brtsegs pa/ rdo rje 80 sder mo/ skar ma'i yum 86 / gza'i nad 87 zhi byed/ zangs 89 mchu dmar po/ kha mchu 95 nag po/ stag mos 96 zhus pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud las rtog pa 102 dang po'i le'u/ 'bum chung 104 du grags pa/ kau shi ka'i 107 bshags mdo/ tshigs 109 su bcad pa gcig pa/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa 110 / ljon shing gi 111 mdo/ sdong pos 112 brgyan pa'i bzlog pa/ gtsug tor 113 gdugs nag mo/ lha mo rol ma 116 / gtsug tor dkar 122 mo'i bzlog bsgyur/ rgyal po'i cho 'phrul 124 ston pa phyir bzlog pa/ sdig sgrib 125 kun 'joms/ rdo rje rgyal 126 mtshan gyi yongs su bsngo ba rnams so// //smras pa/ gang zhig thos na dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan// de don bsams na spro ba'i lo 'dab g.yo// rtse gcig bsgoms na blo mchog sangs rgyas kyi// 'bras bu smin byed dam chos ljon pa'i shing*// gang gi mthu yis mi mthun rgud pa kun// ring du bcom nas srid zhi'i 'dod pa dgu// nyer 'jo bum pa bzang po 'di thob nas// bde 'byor sgrub byed phal la re ba lhod// grogs dag skyabs gnas bsten byar mang mchis kyang*// mi bslu nges pa dkon mchog gsum 'dra su// 'od bkrag 'byin pa'i rgyu skar grangs med dbus// ku mud bzhad pa'i 'od can cang srid dam// 'jam pa'i ngos gzhir bkod legs mtshan byang gis// dgos pa bde blags rtogs byed 'di byas tshe// nyung ngu 'tshol la mang po'i dka' tshegs kyi// rgyus med stong rtsol byed pa'i rang gzugs zhig

/dam chos tshan rdzogs dkar chag 'phang 'gro'i rgyud// ming tshig tshogs pa'i sor mos brdungs pa las// bzhugs pa'i go rim grangs bcas ston pa yi// sgra snyan rna bar 'bab pa de tsam mo// slar yang bde gshegs gsung rab bsod nams kyi// zhing du nyer bskrun bkur stir bgyis pa dang*// grag stong skye 'gag med pa'i gdangs kyi glur// bklags pa las byung rnam dkar dge ba dang*// skye nas skye bar legs byas kha ba'i rdul// bsags pa ji snyed legs bsdoms gangs kyi ri// shes rab nyin mor byed pas bzhu ba gang*// dga' bde mchog gi rgya mtshor 'dre bar bgyi// phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas thams cad mkhyen// thub gsung dri mas dben pa chu yi gter// dbyar gyi dpal mor phyogs bzhin bskal pa'i yun// gzhar yang bri med gong nas gong 'phel shog /smra ba mkhas pa'i sa 'dzin grangs med dag /bshad sgrub phrin las gser gyi 'khor lo yis// rgyal bstan sa stengs rdzogs par mnga' sgyur tshe// bar chad yid srubs g.yul las rnam rgyal shog /phyogs bral la 'khod dge la 'dun pa'i sde// dpag yas 'dus pa li khri'i tshon mdangs kyis// thun mtshams lang tsho'i khengs pa 'gog bgyid cing*// chos mthun spyod gtsang rnam par 'phel gyur cig /rgyal khams yangs pa'i gzhir 'khod skye bo cog /chos min bgyi ba ring spangs dge ba bcur// longs su spyad pas mthong chos slad mar bcas// 'bras bu bde dang dge la reg gyur cig /brtse med gdung byed nad yams mu ge dang*// 'khrug rtsod skal ngan rnams ni 'khor ba pa'i// bde ba gzhom slad snyigs ma'i tshul bzung nas// lhags snyam de dag rmeg med zhi gyur cig /bstan la ches dga'i ru mtshon srid pa'i rtser// snyegs par sgreng ba dkar po'i phyogs gyur lha// 'jig rten khams su bde skyid sar pa'i dpal// spel ba'i mthun rkyen bsgrub la spro ba skyed// mkha' dbyings sprin gyi 'thor yab kyis gtor ba'i// dag byed zegs mas bkrus pa'i gser ldan ma// dgyes pas rtsi shing lo thog 'bru yi tshogs// legs pa'i lang tsho dar bab 'gro la ngoms// khyad par sbyin ba'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi// nad dang gdon bgegs dus min 'chi 'pho dang*// dbul phongs kha smras mtshan ltas ngan pa'i phyogs// mun nang sgron ma bteg ltar zhi gyur cig

/bsod nams ri bo'i phrag nas tshe yi klung*// chad pa med pa'i rgyun 'bebs dbang thang shing*// rnam par rgyas las dge ba'i me tog 'dzum// bde skyid 'bras bu gzhon nu smin par shog /sngon byung rgyal bas ma bsgral 'khor ba'i mtshor// sdug bsngal chu srin mche ba'i phrag gnas pa'i// 'gro tshogs chos kyi dpyangs thag la brten nas// thar pa'i khang bzang 'dren pa bdag gyur cig /gang zhig blo gtad mi bslu gtam gyi rnga// ched du brdungs pa med par ldir ba'i dbyangs// phyogs kyi snyan khung yongs khyab bden pa des// de skad smon pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces pa bka' nye bar mkho ba rnams gcig tu bsdebs pa'i glegs bam 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i bum bzang zhes bya ba'i chos sbyin 'dzad med phyi mor bsgrubs zin pa la/ slar yang de'i chos tshan gyi go rim dang rnam grangs bde blag tu rtogs pa'i dkar chag bsngo smon bcas pa 'di bzhin dgos zhes don du gnyer ba 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal ba nyid dang rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i skal ba sbom por gyur pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas/ dus kyi pho nya zhes bya ba'i lo la/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
